patterns: How do you convert voice to text
What speech recognition technique is used
Tell me about speech to text
How do you hear my voice
responses: Speech Recognition captures acoustic waveforms from your microphone, performs Fourier Transforms to extract Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) or spectrograms, and decodes phonemes into text tokens using acoustic and language models.

Voice input is processed either via the Web Speech API (real-time streaming acoustic model) or PyAudio/Google Speech Recognition, converting audio signals into normalized text strings for deep learning classification.
The system digitizes speech at 16kHz/44.1kHz, applies noise cancellation, tokenizes phonemes, and decodes the transcription for natural language intent analysis.

patterns: What deep learning model do you use
How is deep learning used here
Tell me about the deep learning model
responses: My core engine is a Deep Multilayer Perceptron (DNN) with 3 dense hidden layers, Batch Normalization, ReLU activations, Dropout regularizers (0.3-0.4), and a Softmax output layer trained with Cross-Entropy Loss on intent embeddings.

I utilize a Deep Learning classifier that takes Bag-of-Words and lemmatized token vectors, passes them through fully connected linear layers with non-linear activations, and outputs class probability distributions across distinct intents.
The neural architecture features an input vocabulary projection layer (size |V|), hidden layers of dimension 128, 64, and 32 with dropout for regularization, optimized using Adam optimizer.

I can: 1) Listen and transcribe your spoken voice in real-time, 2) Classify intents using Deep Learning, 3) Display transcription and neural confidence scores, and 4) Provide spoken responses via Text-to-Speech synthesis!
You can ask me about Speech Recognition, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, weather, time, college assessment details, or general queries via voice or text.
My capabilities include Voice-to-Text transcription, Deep Neural Intent Classification, interactive multi-turn dialogue, confidence metric evaluation, and Speech Synthesis.

patterns: What is speech and language processing
Tell me about phonetics and phonology
responses: Speech and Language Processing (SLP) bridges acoustic speech science and computational linguistics, enabling machines to transcribe spoken phonemes and semantically comprehend human language.
Intent classification is a fundamental NLP task where an input utterance is mapped to a discrete semantic category representing the speaker's goal or intention.
SLP encompasses signal processing (Fourier analysis, spectrograms, MFCCs), statistical acoustic modeling (HMMs, CTC, Conformer, Whisper), and language representation (Word2Vec, DNNs, Transformers).

patterns: Tell me about this lab assessment
responses: This project satisfies the 20-mark SLP Lab Assessment: Develop, implement, and deploy an online Voice-Enabled Chatbot using Speech Recognition and Deep Learning, with public hosting and full metrics reporting.

The assessment requires: 1) Speech Recognition integration, 2) Deep Learning intent classification model, 3) Displaying recognized speech and chatbot response, 4) Online public deployment, and 5) Comprehensive technical report.
This submission features live speech recognition, a PyTorch Deep Neural Network, dual display of transcription & intent response, and a publicly accessible deployment link.
